name: Sunny Clover
desc: A cheerful little clover that turns to face the morning light.
funcDesc: gives villagers a tiny mood boost when nibbled on.

name: Puffcap Mushroom
desc: A soft round mushroom that releases a gentle poof of spores when tapped.
funcDesc: pops a harmless cloud that makes nearby critters giggle.

name: Dew Grass
desc: Slender grass blades that always seem to hold a single sparkling droplet.
funcDesc: refills a watering can with a splash of fresh dew.

name: Buttercup Sprout
desc: A tiny yellow sprout that hums with quiet contentment.
funcDesc: brews into a mild tea that soothes tired farmers.

name: Pebble Moss
desc: A cushiony moss that grows happily over old stones and forgotten paths.
funcDesc: softens rocky tiles so villagers can nap on them.

name: Whistling Reed
desc: A hollow reed that sings a soft note whenever the wind passes through.
funcDesc: can be carved into a tiny whistle for calling pets.

name: Firefly Fern
desc: A feathery fern that glimmers faintly after dusk like caught starlight.
funcDesc: lights up dim garden paths just enough to see your feet.

name: Honeybell Flower
desc: A dangling bell-shaped bloom that drips with sweet golden nectar.
funcDesc: attracts friendly bees who help pollinate your whole farm.

name: Moonpetal Lily
desc: A pale lily that only opens its petals under moonlight.
funcDesc: brewed into a calming potion that helps villagers sleep deeply.

name: Chatterleaf Bush
desc: A bush whose leaves rustle in patterns that almost sound like gossip.
funcDesc: warns you with a rustle whenever someone sneaks into your garden.

name: Blueberry Bramble
desc: A thorny bramble bursting with plump, tart little blueberries.
funcDesc: yields a handful of berries perfect for jam-making contests.

name: Crystal Thistle
desc: A spiky thistle whose petals have hardened into tiny glittering crystals.
funcDesc: can be ground into shimmer-dust for enchanting simple tools.

name: Emberbloom
desc: A fiery orange flower that stays warm to the touch even in winter.
funcDesc: keeps a small room cozy for a full chilly night.

name: Whisperwillow Sapling
desc: A tiny willow that seems to murmur old forgotten lullabies in the breeze.
funcDesc: soothes crying babies and grumpy livestock alike.

name: Glasswing Orchid
desc: An elegant orchid with petals so translucent they catch rainbows in sunlight.
funcDesc: prized by collectors for its dazzling display at village fairs.

name: Stormroot Vine
desc: A hardy vine that crackles faintly with static after a thunderstorm.
funcDesc: charges tiny gadgets when draped near a windowsill.

name: Starseed Blossom
desc: A rare flower said to have grown from a fallen star, glowing softly through the night.
funcDesc: grants a wish-like blessing to one lucky villager per season.

name: Evergold Tree Sprout
desc: A miniature sapling with leaves of shimmering gold that never wilt.
funcDesc: slowly generates a trickle of coins if planted and cared for.

name: Dreamvine Orchid
desc: A mysterious orchid whose fragrance is said to pull sweet dreams from the air.
funcDesc: lets villagers share a dream together when brewed as tea.

name: Phoenix Fern
desc: An ancient fern that bursts into gentle flame and regrows anew each dawn.
funcDesc: regrows itself endlessly, never truly dying no matter what.

name: Puddle Duck
desc: A cheerful duckling that quacks at every rain puddle it finds.
funcDesc: waddles around leaving tiny wet footprints everywhere.

name: Meadow Mouse
desc: A tiny mouse with a nose for clover and mischief.
funcDesc: nibbles your garden fence when it thinks nobody's looking.

name: Pebble Snail
desc: A slow, sweet snail whose shell looks like a painted river stone.
funcDesc: leaves sparkly trails that make great treasure maps.

name: Sock Bunny
desc: A fluffy bunny that hoards odd socks for its cozy burrow.
funcDesc: steals one sock from every laundry line it hops past.

name: Dust Kitten
desc: A soft grey kitten born from sunlit attic dust.
funcDesc: sneezes little puffs of glitter when it's happy.

name: Twig Beetle
desc: A tiny beetle disguised as a wandering twig.
funcDesc: clicks its shell like tiny castanets when excited.

name: Moth Lantern
desc: A gentle moth whose wings glow like a paper lantern at dusk.
funcDesc: lights up dim garden paths just by fluttering nearby.

name: Garden Toad
desc: A round toad who guards the vegetable patch like a tiny knight.
funcDesc: croaks proudly whenever a snail dares cross its lettuce.

name: Barn Sparrow
desc: A chirpy sparrow that nests in the rafters of every barn it visits.
funcDesc: sings off-key lullabies that somehow still work.

name: Moon Hare
desc: A silvery hare said to hop between moonbeams on clear nights.
funcDesc: thumps its foot to summon a little shower of stardust.

name: Ember Fox
desc: A warm-furred fox with a tail that flickers like campfire light.
funcDesc: curls up by your feet and toasts marshmallows with its tail.

name: Whisper Owl
desc: A quiet owl that speaks only in soft, secretive hoots.
funcDesc: tells you tomorrow's weather if you ask it nicely.

name: Jelly Slime
desc: A wobbly, translucent slime that jiggles happily in the sun.
funcDesc: bounces into any container and holds its shape for snacks.

name: Star Snail
desc: A snail whose shell holds a tiny swirling galaxy inside.
funcDesc: hums faint constellations while it slowly explores your shelf.

name: Cloud Sheep
desc: A fluffy sheep so light it occasionally drifts a few inches off the ground.
funcDesc: sheds soft cloud-fluff that never seems to run out.

name: Glass Deer
desc: A delicate deer with antlers of clear, singing crystal.
funcDesc: chimes a gentle melody with every careful step it takes.

name: Ink Raven
desc: A sleek raven whose feathers drip like fresh calligraphy ink.
funcDesc: writes tiny secret messages wherever it perches.

name: Tide Turtle
desc: An ancient turtle whose shell holds a miniature tide pool ecosystem.
funcDesc: carries a whole tiny beach around on its back.

name: Aurora Stag
desc: A majestic stag whose antlers ripple with borrowed northern lights.
funcDesc: paints the night sky above your farm whenever it wanders out.

name: Sun Phoenix
desc: A radiant phoenix that rises anew each morning with the village sunrise.
funcDesc: warms the whole village square just by stretching its wings.

name: Straw Sunhat
desc: A wide-brimmed hat woven from golden farm straw, perfect for lazy afternoons.
funcDesc: keeps the sun out of your eyes and the hay in your hair.

name: Woolly Mittens
desc: Thick mittens knitted from freshly sheared village wool.
funcDesc: warms chilly paws faster than a cup of cocoa.

name: Patchwork Scarf
desc: A cheerful scarf stitched together from leftover fabric scraps.
funcDesc: wraps snugly around your neck and shows off your love of thrift.

name: Muddy Rain Boots
desc: Sturdy boots that have already made peace with every puddle in town.
funcDesc: lets you stomp through mud without a single complaint.

name: Knit Beanie
desc: A soft little beanie topped with a bouncy pom-pom.
funcDesc: keeps your head toasty and your pom-pom bouncing.

name: Cotton Apron
desc: A simple apron dusted with flour from countless kitchen mishaps.
funcDesc: catches spills before they ruin your favorite shirt.

name: Buttoned Vest
desc: A tidy vest with brass buttons polished by loving hands.
funcDesc: adds a dash of dapper to any farmer's outfit.

name: Striped Socks
desc: Cheerful striped socks that never quite match each other.
funcDesc: keeps toes warm and mismatched on purpose.

name: Linen Tunic
desc: A breathable tunic ideal for tending gardens under the summer sun.
funcDesc: lets you weed the garden without breaking a sweat.

name: Cozy Slippers
desc: Fluffy slippers shaped like sleepy little bunnies.
funcDesc: turns every walk to the fridge into a soft hop.

name: Embroidered Shawl
desc: A shawl embroidered with tiny blooming flowers by the village seamstress.
funcDesc: adds a touch of elegance to fireside gatherings.

name: Feathered Cap
desc: A jaunty cap adorned with a single bright feather.
funcDesc: makes every hello feel like a grand entrance.

name: Leather Satchel Belt
desc: A rugged belt with a small satchel for carrying foraged treasures.
funcDesc: holds your acorns, berries, and secrets alike.

name: Moonlit Cloak
desc: A cloak that seems to shimmer faintly under starlight.
funcDesc: makes nighttime strolls feel a little magical.

name: Silver Locket Necklace
desc: A delicate locket holding a tiny pressed flower inside.
funcDesc: keeps a small memory close to your heart.

name: Dragonscale Gloves
desc: Gloves crafted from shimmering scales said to be shed by a friendly dragon.
funcDesc: lets you handle hot pots without a single yelp.

name: Starwoven Cape
desc: A cape threaded with strands that twinkle like distant stars.
funcDesc: turns heads and catches wishes wherever you wander.

name: Phoenix Feather Boa
desc: A boa made from feathers rumored to glow warm even in winter.
funcDesc: keeps you toasty and fabulously dramatic all season.

name: Crown of Whispering Leaves
desc: An ancient crown woven from leaves that murmur old forest secrets.
funcDesc: lets you hear the forest's gossip if you listen closely.

name: Robe of the Eternal Harvest
desc: A radiant robe stitched from threads blessed by the village's oldest harvest festival.
funcDesc: makes crops grow a little sweeter wherever you wander.

name: Rickety Cart
desc: An old wooden cart that creaks with every turn but never quite falls apart.
funcDesc: hauls your goods around town while making delightfully spooky squeaky noises.

name: Garden Wheelbarrow
desc: A trusty single-wheeled helper perfect for hauling flowers and vegetables.
funcDesc: lets you tote pumpkins twice your size without breaking a sweat.

name: Bicycle Built for Two
desc: A cheerful tandem bike painted in mismatched patches of color.
funcDesc: doubles the fun, and the pedaling, for you and a friend.

name: Mail Wagon
desc: A sturdy little wagon that always smells faintly of fresh parchment.
funcDesc: zips letters and parcels across town before the ink even dries.

name: Hay Cart
desc: A rustic cart piled high with golden hay and the occasional sleepy cat.
funcDesc: rolls slow and steady, perfect for lazy countryside afternoons.

name: Pony Trap
desc: A dainty two-wheeled carriage pulled by a very opinionated pony.
funcDesc: trots you around town while judging your fashion choices.

name: Rowboat
desc: A little wooden boat that bobs happily along the village pond.
funcDesc: paddles you across the water at a leisurely, splashy pace.

name: Sled
desc: A simple wooden sled worn smooth by countless snowy winters.
funcDesc: slides you down hills with zero brakes and maximum giggles.

name: Scooter
desc: A wobbly little scooter with a bell that rings a bit too enthusiastically.
funcDesc: gets you around town quick, provided you can keep your balance.

name: Steam Trolley
desc: A charming little trolley that puffs cheerful clouds of steam as it trundles along its tracks.
funcDesc: chugs along fixed rails, tooting its whistle at every corner.

name: Hot Air Balloon
desc: A patchwork balloon that drifts lazily above rooftops, trailing ribbons in the wind.
funcDesc: floats you gently skyward for the best view of the village.

name: Canal Barge
desc: A flower-draped barge that glides quietly through the village's winding canals.
funcDesc: ferries goods and gossip along the water at a peaceful crawl.

name: Windmill Kite Cart
desc: A quirky cart fitted with spinning kite-sails that catch every passing breeze.
funcDesc: zooms forward whenever the wind decides to cooperate.

name: Clockwork Unicycle
desc: A brass unicycle powered by a tiny, ticking clockwork heart.
funcDesc: needs winding every mile but never complains about the workout.

name: Firefly Lantern Boat
desc: A tiny boat lit by a swarm of friendly fireflies who insist on riding along.
funcDesc: lights your way home through the darkest village nights.

name: Cloud Skiff
desc: A silvery little skiff that somehow floats on nothing but soft morning mist.
funcDesc: sails through the clouds as if gravity simply forgot to apply.

name: Turtle-Drawn Carriage
desc: An ancient tortoise pulls this mossy carriage with the patience of a thousand years.
funcDesc: arrives eventually, fashionably late but wonderfully dignified.

name: Star Wagon
desc: A wagon whose wheels leave a trail of twinkling stardust behind them.
funcDesc: rolls you home under a sky it seems to borrow light from.

name: Mushroom Trolley
desc: A trolley grown from a giant, glowing mushroom cap, favored by woodland folk.
funcDesc: bounces along on springy fungal wheels that never go flat.

name: Moonlit Comet Sleigh
desc: A radiant sleigh said to be carved from a fallen comet, granting safe travel under any moon.
funcDesc: streaks across the sky leaving a trail of stardust and envious neighbors.

name: Dew Berry
desc: A tiny berry that glistens with morning dew no matter the hour.
funcDesc: tastes like sunrise and gives a tiny happy hiccup.

name: Bread Root
desc: A knobby vegetable that smells faintly of a fresh-baked loaf.
funcDesc: crumbles like toast and pairs well with butter jokes.

name: Puffcap Mushroom
desc: A round little mushroom that sighs a soft puff of spores when picked.
funcDesc: squeaks when squeezed and leaves a faint sparkle dust.

name: Honey Pod
desc: A pod bursting with slow-dripping golden honey.
funcDesc: sticky sweet stuff that attracts three grateful bees.

name: Cloud Turnip
desc: A pale turnip so light it nearly floats out of the basket.
funcDesc: bobs gently and boils into fluffy mash.

name: Sunpetal Fruit
desc: A citrus fruit shaped like a tiny sun with warm orange rind.
funcDesc: zesty snack that perks up sleepy villagers.

name: Mossy Egg
desc: An egg wrapped naturally in a thin coat of soft green moss.
funcDesc: cracks open with a earthy little pop.

name: Sugar Cabbage
desc: A cabbage so sweet children mistake it for candy.
funcDesc: crunches sugary and pairs well with everything.

name: Riverclam Cake
desc: A savory little cake shaped like a smiling clam shell.
funcDesc: chewy treat that smells faintly of the sea.

name: Nutty Acorn Bun
desc: A soft roll baked around a whole roasted acorn.
funcDesc: nutty surprise hidden in every warm bite.

name: Star Grapes
desc: Tiny grapes that twinkle faintly like distant stars at dusk.
funcDesc: pop with a shimmer and taste of cool night air.

name: Whistling Pear
desc: A pear that hums a soft note when the wind passes through its core.
funcDesc: toots gently when bitten, startling nearby chickens.

name: Moonfin Roe
desc: Pearly fish eggs that glow faintly under moonlight.
funcDesc: pops on the tongue with a cool silvery fizz.

name: Emberroot Stew Base
desc: A fiery red root that keeps simmering long after it's picked.
funcDesc: stays warm all day, perfect for lazy campfires.

name: Velvet Fig
desc: A plush fig with skin as soft as a well-loved blanket.
funcDesc: squishy sweet bite that somehow feels like a hug.

name: Dragonpepper
desc: A tiny pepper said to hold a spark of ancient dragonfire.
funcDesc: one bite and you'll be breathing tiny smoke rings for hours.

name: Silverleaf Tea Bloom
desc: A flower whose petals brew into the calmest tea in the village.
funcDesc: steeps into pure tranquility, no kettle whistle needed.

name: Golden Yolk Truffle
desc: A rare fungus that tastes exactly like a perfectly fried egg.
funcDesc: chefs weep tiny joyful tears when they find one.

name: Phoenixberry
desc: A blazing berry that regrows on its bush the instant it's eaten.
funcDesc: never runs out, much to every merchant's confusion.

name: Ancient Starloaf
desc: A bread said to have been baked by the very first village baker under a falling star.
funcDesc: never goes stale and grants one wish-worthy nap afterward.
